substrate_ms_id: sample_id of the maize silage used as rumen incubation substrate
substrate_ms_mg: amount of maize silage (mg) added for rumen incubation substrate (exact)
substrate_gs_id: sample_id of the grass silage used as rumen incubation substrate
substrate_gs_mg: amount of grass silage (mg) added for rumen incubation substrate  (exact)
substrate_conc_id: sample_id of the concentrate used as rumen incubation substrate
substrate_conc_mg: amount of concentrate (mg) added for rumen incubation substrate  (exact)
substrate_straw_id: sample_id of the straw used as rumen incubation substrate
substrate_straw_mg: amount of straw (mg) added for rumen incubation substrate  (exact)
inocula_id: id of the inoculum collected, used for tracing extra inoculum characteristics in motherfile
inocula_date: date of the inoculum collection, format <dd/mm/yyyy>
trt_label_1: a custom label for treatment which can be used for the statistical analysis, e.g. high starch
trt_label_2: a custom label for treatment  which can be used for the statistical analysis, e.g. high starch
trt_label_3: a custom label for treatment which can be used for the statistical analysis, e.g. high starch
trt_rep_1_type: treatment replacement type (treatment which replaces a certain amount of substrate)
trt_rep_1_id: treatment replacement id (treatment which replaces a certain amount of substrate)
